@kenjiuno/msgreader 1.29.0, browser bundle with Buffer compatibility shims:
https://github.com/HiraokaHyperTools/msgreader
Build-only esbuild 0.25.12; exact dependency versions/integrity in dependencies-lock.json.
Entry exports MsgReader; Buffer is injected into the bundle scope, not the site's global scope.

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 with tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, LSTM-only cores:
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core

English language data: @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz:
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata

Libraries are self-hosted and loaded on demand. No original employee files
or employee photographs are included in these assets. OCR languages, workers
and core files use same-origin URLs; no third-party processing is invoked.
